full_name: Participation and Activity Inventory (PAI; formerly Dutch ICF Activity Inventory)
domains: ICF Activity and Participation domains plus Emotional Health: learning and applying knowledge; general tasks and demands; communication; mobility; self-care; domestic life; interpersonal interactions; major life areas; community, social and civic life; emotional health (Table 3 p7)
response_scale: importance 0-3 (not important or not applicable, slightly, moderately, very); difficulty 0-4 (not, slightly, moderately, very difficult or impossible) asked only if importance >= 1
scoring: Priority score (PAI-PS) = importance x difficulty per goal (0-12), mean over goals per person; Rasch person measure (PAI-PM) in logits from difficulty scores, higher = more difficulty (p4, p5)
target_population: adults with acquired visual impairment entering vision rehabilitation
notes: Single Andrich rating scale model, Winsteps 4.0.1; categories 1 and 2 combined; goal 610 removed (infit 2.36 outfit 5.14) leaving 47 goals; person separation 3.16, person reliability 0.91, targeting 0.79, item separation 2.47, item reliability 0.86, 46% variance explained (Table 2 p6, p6). Original CTT development cited, not reported here (p2). Dutch language inferred only from instrument name/context; translation validation NR
